data.display_address: Mercer House, Uptown Dubai, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai
data.long_description:
Mercer House introduces residents to the urban sophistication of the vibrant Uptown Dubai district. Nestled in two striking towers that gracefully punctuate the skyline, Mercer House offers sweeping vistas of the dynamic cityscape and the pristine Dubai coastline. With opulent studios, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as luxurious four-bedroom penthouses, residents will enjoy a curated lifestyle and exclusive amenities. From a 45,000 sq. ft. beach club, an array of retail and shopping options, and a multi-sports complex featuring various ball games and sports, to resident-access family and skyline pools, and state-of-the art fitness studios, and spa rooms.

AMENITIES

– Urban beach club
– Retail and F&B shops
– Multi-sports hall
– Padel and squash courts
– Family and skyline pools
– Sing and dance revolution area
– Arcade-themed area
– Clubhouse
– Fitness studio
– Scenic sauna and ice room

Uptown Dubai, located next to Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT) is an ideal residential community for families and individuals who appreciate a panoramic waterfront promenade and breathtaking landscapes. Situated across from the world-class Dubai Marina, JLT offers a relaxed community feel with a range of amenities. It is home to retail outlets, offices, and a vast array of dining, shopping, recreation, and entertainment options, making it a popular spot for enjoying life’s finer pleasures.
